body:
Two related CLI commits.

**1. `--set-titleblock` — stamp title-block fields headlessly.** The first write-to-project CLI command, aimed at CI / revision workflows:
```
qelectrotech --set-titleblock in.qet out.qet revision=B date=today author="CI"
```
Stamps fields onto every folio (and the project default), then saves. Standard keys map to the documented title-block fields (title, author, date, plant, location, revision, version, filename); `date=today` uses the current date and an explicit date forces `UseDateValue`; any other key becomes a custom title-block field. Assignments are parsed up front so a malformed one fails before writing. Addresses the 'saving' side of #162.

**2. Fix an intermittent headless segfault (see #492).** `QETProject` schedules an async crash-recovery backup on construction (`writeBackup()` → `QtConcurrent::run(QET::writeToFile, …, &m_backup_file)`). In one-shot CLI mode the project is destroyed as the command returns while that background write still references `m_backup_file` — a use-after-free crash (~1 in 6 runs; also hits the merged `--resave`). Fix: `QETProject::setBackupEnabled(false)` from the CLI entry in `main()`, so no backup write is launched in headless mode (it's meaningless for a one-shot command). The deeper general fix is left to you in #492.

Built and verified on Qt5 + KF5 (Ubuntu): 0 crashes in 40 runs (was ~1/6), stamped fields persist, dates stored correctly, malformed input rejected.

*Developed with assistance from Claude (Anthropic).*

The first write-to-project CLI command, aimed at CI / revision workflows:
stamp title-block metadata onto every folio (and the project default),
then save. Each argument is key=value:

  qelectrotech --set-titleblock in.qet out.qet revision=B date=today

Standard keys map to the documented title-block fields (title, author,
date, plant, location, revision, version, filename); date=today uses the
current date and an explicit date forces UseDateValue mode; any other key
is stored as a custom title-block field. Assignments are parsed up front
so a malformed one fails before writing.

Addresses the 'saving' side of the CLI-for-scripts request (#162).
commits.messageHeadline: CLI: add --set-titleblock to stamp title-block fields headlessly

In one-shot CLI mode the QETProject is destroyed as soon as the command

launched. Fixes the crash for all CLI commands. See #492.
